name: comic-panels
title: Comic Panels
description: The frame cracks into a three-panel comic page with speed lines and halftone, then the action panel bursts into a full-frame word such as POW. A built-in lockup stands in for the hero; a host replaces the contents of the .cp-hero layer with its own logo or headline.
useWhen: A logo, product or headline should land with comic-book energy, framed in a hero panel with speed lines.
A playful launch or social clip needs a loud sound-effect beat, like POW, ZAP or NEW, that takes over the frame.
The scene should turn from a single hero shot into a page layout in one move.
avoidWhen: You only need the manga-style impact lines around an element, without the page: use speed-lines.
The hit should be a heavy slam with a camera jolt rather than a page cracking: use impact-shake.
The burst should be a sculptural ribbon opener rather than a printed comic page: use radial-burst.
author: Remocn
